fact: One persistent Pi subagent runs the Implement stage, including its measurements, verification, and review rework.
Implementer dispatch selects a versioned playbook from the task type or the Taskbook Playbook field and loads its prompt for each Work State.
Implementer hands off a clean local Git commit after running a successful acceptance command at that revision.
Implementer Consult resolves decisions within the approved plan and gives design or scope questions to the Lead Designer.
Hillclimb runs one experiment at a time against a frozen baseline, then keeps a verified trial commit or rolls it back before the next attempt.
Lead-authorized Review rework returns to the existing Implementer for a revision and Verify, then every revised candidate starts from Initial Review.
